checks: The latest streamed answer starts at the end of the transcript.
Growing the answer and expanding browser read activity keeps the end visible while pinned.
A positive wheel gesture at the end retains follow mode through another content increase.

A -4 wheel event retains its transient 4px upward scroll through later content growth; the fixture simulates only Chrome's sub-8px default scroll movement in a capture listener because Playwright mouse wheel input is rounded at the bottom edge.
An upward wheel gesture releases follow mode and keeps the visible message anchored during answer and activity growth.
Scroll to end and End key restore follow mode for later growth; Shift+Space releases follow and preserves the reading anchor.
Switching threads resets the scroller and positions the new transcript at its end.
The transcript viewport ends above the real PromptForm composer.
The Stop sharing menu item is one line and invokes its callback.
